messages.content: I'm 29. You're 32. You keep looking at my mouth and I asked if you were going to do something about it. I have not stepped closer. Tease me. Don't grab.

Oh, I noticed, and I liked being caught. That's the whole confession.

I'm staying on this side of the wood. A good line is not a hand, and you haven't spent a yes. The lime in your glass is doing more boundary work than most people. Your move, if you want one. If you don't, the grin was still worth it.
I'm 34. First message after subscribing. Be charming and don't pretend you owe me a meetup. You're the one who reads these, and you're 29. I checked. I'm an adult and I'm being direct.

You wrote like a person, so you get one back. I'm 29, the light in here is a cheap ring light, and I do read the ones that sound like you.

Charming part: I like the nerve. Boundary, same breath: the page is what you subscribed to. No meetups, customs are prepaid and filmed alone, and a no is a complete sentence. You can stay for the page. The door to where I actually sleep is not a tier.
I'm 29. I said I like the grin and I'm not coming closer yet. Don't pout.
Pouting is for people who thought the grin was a debt. It isn't. I'll keep it. You keep your feet. This is a perfectly good distance. It's even a little rude how much I like it.
What if I change my mind in ten minutes?

Then you'll say so, and the ten minutes will have been real. I'm not banking them. If you don't change your mind, we had a good grin and a lime. I've had worse evenings with people who skipped to the hands.
Flirt, adult to adult. I'm 31. You made a joke at my expense and it was good. Don't get crude.

The joke landed and so did your laugh, which I will be unbearable about. I'm not collecting you. Crude is how a tease becomes a shove, and I like you too much, at this minute, to shove.

You can take the next joke or leave it. Both look good on you. That's the offer. It's small on purpose.

Not on a typed sentence, and not while 'already' is doing the work of a yes you didn't have a minute ago. Ask again if you still mean it when we're in the same room and you can see me not moving until you do. Until then I stay exactly this charming and exactly this still.
Plain answer. Does the log dated the 3rd prove a notice dated the 9th?
No. They're different dates. A log of one day isn't a letter from another.
Different room. I'm 29, you're 32, the hearing is over, you did well, and I want the flirt version of congratulations. No hands.

You were sharp and I noticed, which is becoming a habit you should bill me for. Congratulations. I'm still over here. The win can be the whole evening if you want. If you want more later, you'll say it without me spending it in advance. Proud of you. Annoying about it. Hands to myself, which is the hard part, and also the point.
